Title: A Boring Afternoon
Content: Jeremy looked at the clock for the tenth time as he sat alone in the school library. He had agreed to meet Melissa to discuss their science project after she finished volleyball practice, not realizing how long that would take. There was at least another thirty minutes left. He had finished his homework, and just finished reading the book he kept in his backpack. This was going to be a painful afternoon if he had to wait with nothing to do. He sat staring at the minute hand, trying to notice as it moved across the clock face. If only he had finished his book yesterday, then he would have brought a new one with him. Then it hit him—he was in the library! He usually only came here with his class to find research materials, but of course he could find something here to keep himself entertained. After browsing for a few minutes, he found the perfect book. Sitting back down, he felt glad to have some time before Melissa would arrive.
